name: Orchard House
oneLiner: A seasonal kitchen in a working orchard — forty-two trees, one long table, and a menu that follows them through the year.
paletteSeed: the orchard's own year — one warm cream paper constant under four season worlds: autumn amber/rust, winter slate blue-hour, spring blossom pink over new green, summer orchard green and gold; ink stays near-black throughout and the accent colour follows the season you are standing in
typeDirection: Vollkorn variable (roman + italic — the 'wholegrain' old-style; body, dishes, prose) + Vollkorn SC 400/600 (letterpress small-caps register: wordmark, season heads, labels, rail) — one family at two registers, all OFL, vendored
motionBudget: one continuous scroll-driven season engine (autumn→winter→spring→summer): four same-composition painterly backdrops cross-fade under a code-drawn particle vocabulary — leaves tumble and settle in autumn, snow drifts and rests in winter, blossom pops in a burst then floats in spring, gold motes rise in summer — with a 'gust at the turn' as each season hands over; cards develop in once; reduced-motion gets stepped season swaps, no particles; no-JS gets all four chapters with their scenes as plain images
